title: Notifications
intro: Choose which updates may reach your browser and phone. These settings apply to your JoyoRogo and JoyoFit account.

social.title: Social
social.desc: Kudos, comments, replies, new followers, and new posts from people you follow.

group.title: Groups: pokes, notes, challenges
group.desc: Pokes, notes from group friends, new members, and challenge updates.

meal.title: Meal reminders
meal.desc: When no food is logged all day, and when your streak is about to break.

weigh.title: Weigh-in reminder
weigh.desc: Once a week if you have not weighed in.

recap.title: Recap & targets
recap.desc: Weekly recap ready, calorie target changed, and this week's meal plan.

quiet.title: Quiet hours
quiet.desc: During quiet hours notifications are held and sent when they end. Times are WIB (Jakarta).

limits: There is a daily limit per category. Anything over it is folded into one evening summary.
devices: Registered: {{web}} browser(s), {{rogo}} JoyoRogo phone(s), {{fit}} JoyoFit phone(s).

status.granted: Notifications are on for this device.
status.undetermined: Notifications are not turned on for this device yet.
status.denied: Notifications are blocked on this device. Turn them on in system settings.
status.unsupported: This device or browser does not support notifications yet.
status.unavailable: Notifications are not available on this server yet.

test.sent: Sent. Check the notifications on your device.
test.skipped: No device or browser is registered yet. Turn notifications on first.
test.failed: The test notification could not be sent. Try again in a moment.

web.subscribed: This browser is registered for notifications.
web.notSubscribed: Permission is granted, but this browser is not registered yet. Turn it on again to register.
web.iosInstall: On iPhone or iPad, browser notifications only work after JoyoRogo is added to the Home Screen (Share, then Add to Home Screen).

move.title: Notifications moved to the new address
move.body: JoyoRogo now lives at app.joyorogo.com. Turn notifications on again here so updates from friends and your reminders keep arriving.

native.reminderNote: Server reminders (no meal logged, weekly weigh-in) are managed in Notifications. If the meal or weigh-in reminder here is on, the server one is skipped so you do not get both.

ask.mealTitle: Get meal reminders and news from friends?
ask.mealMessage: Nice, your first meal is logged! Turn on notifications so JoyoRogo can remind you to log meals and tell you when friends cheer you on. Only useful things, no ads. After this, your system will ask for permission once.
ask.socialMessage: Turn on notifications so you know when someone replies, gives you kudos, follows you or pokes you. Only useful things, no ads. After this, your system will ask for permission once.

banner.text: Notifications are off. Turn them on for meal reminders and news from friends.

meal.name: Meal reminders
meal.description: No meal logged and streak about to break
